text:
Jay (Support): @Maya heads up :rotating_light: Acme trial activation invites are failing with 500s when we hit the send endpoint. 0/45 users activated since 08:12 UTC. Marking P1 and handing to CS for customer comms and retention plan.

Maya (CS): on it. Can you drop the error payload / sample request and confirm whether manual invites still work? we should draft a customer note ASAP.

Jay (Support): sample request below — same for multiple emails. manual invite via admin UI also failing.
```
curl -v 'https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/invites' \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \\n  -d '{"email":"trialuser@acme.com","team_id":"acme-trial"}'
```
Response: HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
{"error":"upstream smtp provider timeout"}

Ravi (Solutions Eng): looks like upstream SMTP provider is timing out (seen spikes on provider side). I can flip to fallback provider for this tenant, need ops approval to rotate provider creds. Workaround: create manual user entries and send invites via alternate provider or share one-time magic links.

Elena (Enablement): for comms: propose short email apologizing + offer 30-min live onboarding tomorrow and manual invites from our side. copy: "We're sorry — we're fixing an issue with invite emails. In the meantime we can add your team and walk through onboarding live." I'll draft if Maya approves.

Lucas (AM): Customer is on tight timeline for pilot next week — priority is keeping them on the platform. Recommend manual add + schedule call now. Also please include credits/waiver if we can't fully resolve before their pilot.

Maya (CS): Agreed. Plan: (1) notify customer now with short apology + workaround (Elena to draft) (2) Offer immediate manual adds for critical users (Ravi to run provider flip or create manual links) (3) Schedule 30-min enablement call for tomorrow (Lucas to propose slots) (4) Ops to create incident and engage eng-oncall.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-1234 created and assigned to eng-oncall. Priority: P1.

Jay (Support): I will attach full logs and timeline to the incident and run the provider flip if ops gives the go.

Ravi (Solutions Eng): I can run a provider flip for the tenant now in a safe window; need confirmation from ops. If flipped, expect invites to start delivering within ~2-4 minutes.

Maya (CS): Elena please post draft comms in this thread when ready. Lucas — can you share the AM outreach plan (who calls, what concessions) so we present a unified front?

Elena (Enablement): Draft below, feel free to edit: "Hi Team — quick note: we're seeing an issue with invite emails and are actively fixing it. We can add your users manually and host a 30-min onboarding session at your convenience. Apologies for the interruption — we'll follow up with a full incident summary and any credits as needed." :white_check_mark:

Lucas (AM): Sending 10:00 or 15:00 PT options now to customer. I'll mention potential credits contingent on incident impact.

Maya (CS): Action items logged. I'll coordinate the call and post a short post-mortem once incident resolved. Adding reactions. :thumbsup:

Jay (Support): attaching timeline to INC-2026-1234 and will keep monitoring.

Ravi (Solutions Eng): ops approved provider flip, I'm doing it now.

ops-bot: Provider switch completed for tenant acme-trial at 08:23 UTC. Deliverability checks passing.

Maya (CS): lovely — please confirm when we can start manual adds for key users and I'll notify customer.

Jay (Support): Manual adds possible now. I've added 6 critical users and emailed them direct magic links.

Maya (CS): Thanks team — keeping this thread as the single source. I'll send the customer comms within 10 minutes and schedule the 30-min session.

Lucas (AM): Customer confirmed 15:00 PT, accepted manual adds and appreciates quick response.

Maya (CS): Closing loop here — incident still open for postmortem but customer escalations handled and pilot preserved. Will file PM with outcomes and compensation recommendation.
